title: x63 follow-up (minor): MemoryConfig validation + retry-after-failure integration test
description:
Two non-blocking minor items from the final whole-epic review of loreweaver-x63 (post commit c760cd4):

1. No MemoryConfig validation (arcRolloverThreshold <= 0, non-integer, recapWindowSize <= 0). N=0 would attempt rollover with zero recaps on every close. Add a small validator that runs when memoryConfig is set on PlayDeps (or at first use) and throws on out-of-range values.

2. Missing integration test for the documented graceful-degradation path: rollover model call fails at session N, then succeeds at session N+1 with N+1 recaps. The unhappy-path single-failure case is covered; the across-failures-then-recovers case is not.

Plus: see x63.8 for the closeOpenArcAndOpenNext follow-ups already filed.
